description:
- Every patch description is shorter and stops naming internals. **Fix photo upload in cloned installs** is now **Fix photo upload in clones**, so check that one is still selected when you repatch; the other six keep their names.
- The per-app gotchas that no patch description covers moved into the app's own section of the patches list in the README, written by hand in `.github/notes/<app>.md` and pulled in when the list is generated.

在 Morphe Manager 加入這個 patch 來源，或下載下面的 `.mpp` 手動匯入。
